sections.title: History
sections.content:
Divine Wolf resided in Vilanciel, and considered as the guardian deity of that world. Its existence then discovered by the Emperor of Bariura, who wanted to take it to Grand Gaia and used its power as the trump card during the war against the Gods. After Selvia finished the preparation, the Emperor headed to Vilanciel with Sirius, Selvia, and several other people to confront the Divine Wolf. At first, they wanted to use Balamgram to force the wolf to obey them, but Balamgram was too difficult to control. The Divine Wolf then defeated the people from Bariura, and inflicted mortal wounds to the Emperor of Bariura. After the death of his father, Sirius then chose to make peace with the Divine Wolf and resided in Vilanciel until his last breath.

In the present time, people of Vilanciel, who are the descendants of those who arrived from Bariura, continue to worship the Divine Wolf as the guardian deity of Vilanciel.
